protected_invariants.heading: Scoring Thresholds
protected_invariants.text: - **1-2:** Title only or one-liner.

protected_invariants.heading: Shaped Status Rules
protected_invariants.text: - **no** = Empty, title-only, or just a problem statement with no shaping.

protected_invariants.heading: Shaped Status Rules
protected_invariants.text: **Key rule:** If rabbit holes are listed but not resolved (no answers, no owners, no evidence of investigation), the pitch is `partial` regardless of other scores. Rabbit hole resolution is a shaping exit criterion — they must be addressed DURING shaping, not deferred to build.

protected_invariants.heading: Verdict Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Verdict must match shaped status. A `partial` pitch CANNOT have a "ready to bet" verdict.

protected_invariants.heading: Review Output Rules
protected_invariants.text: - **Next actions must be specific to THIS pitch.** Not generic template advice. If the advice could apply to any pitch without modification, it doesn't belong in the review.

protected_invariants.heading: Review Output Rules
protected_invariants.text: - **Scores must be consistent.** The same pitch reviewed twice must produce the same score. If appetite-scaling changes the score, note why.
